parsed.name: 伺服式光纤振动器
parsed.description: 一种用于实验光路中的光纤振动装置，采用无刷直流电机并通过 50 Hz PWM 信号控制。可对光纤进行机械振动/抖动，用于需要光纤扰动的实验场景。
parsed.description_en: A fiber-shaking device for laboratory optical setups, using a brushless DC motor controlled by a 50 Hz PWM signal. It mechanically shakes the fiber for experiments that require fiber perturbation or agitation.

actions.description: 开启伺服式光纤振动器，开始对光纤进行振动。
actions.description_en: Turn on the servo fiber shaker and start shaking the fiber.

actions.description: 关闭伺服式光纤振动器，停止光纤振动。
actions.description_en: Turn off the servo fiber shaker and stop fiber shaking.
